conclusion.statement: The last accepted real authorization request and the current rejected authorization request use identical endpoint, method, safe header-name set, model, store, stream, temperature, max_tokens, message-role envelope, provider routing, response-format wrapper, strict mode, root type, root required fields, and additionalProperties policy. Material changes are Package B request-scoped aliasing and Package C provider-schema name/binding/reference constraints. Offline evidence ranks the nine-pattern schema as the strongest construct-level compatibility hypothesis but cannot prove provider causality.

authorizationEconomicsControlRegression.whyRegressionCannotBeProvenOffline: The repository records the accepted and rejected bodies and reproduces both exactly, but the provider returned no structured output or allowlisted parameter path. Multiple schema deltas were introduced across Packages B/C and provider behavior may also have changed between live dates.

syntheticComparison.sizeFinding: Request size alone is contradicted: the current rejected request is smaller than the accepted real request, and the accepted Gold-shaped synthetic lineage recorded an 18,830-byte request.

schemaTranslationAudit.translatorBehavior: Recursively removes only minLength, maxLength, and maxItems; it retains type, properties, required, additionalProperties, const, enum, pattern, arrays, minItems, and anyOf.
materialChanges: enum nodes decreased from 12 to 5; packet-specific reference enums were removed
const count decreased from 15 to 13; issueId and inputHash request-binding consts moved to deterministic local validation
schema depth decreased from 8 to 7 while node count remained 76
required fields, object closure, array-schema count, minItems count, and anyOf count are unchanged
fixed requiredEvidenceClasses enum is broader than the historical authorization-specific subset
schemaTranslationAudit.unsupportedKeywordFinding: No repository evidence proves that any retained keyword is categorically unsupported. The newly repeated pattern construct is a compatibility hypothesis, not a finding of an exact provider restriction.

A_OPENROUTER_REQUEST_LEVEL.evidence: OpenRouter returned HTTP 400 before structured output with MALFORMED_REQUEST / REQUEST_PARAMETER_REJECTED / invalid_request_error.

B_ROUTED_ANTHROPIC_STRUCTURED_OUTPUT.evidence: No model output or returned model identity was available; a routed provider may have rejected response_format before generation, but that layer is not distinguishable from the safe response.

C_LOCAL_CONSTRUCTION_TRANSLATION.evidence: Local code deterministically constructed a different schema/body and the hashes reproduce repository evidence exactly; local validators passed before transport.

safeErrorTelemetryAudit.parsingFinding: The runtime parses nested error.metadata.raw JSON and inspects nested error.type/code/param/parameter/message, but safeProviderParameter retains only exact allowlisted roots. A more specific dotted or JSON-pointer parameter path is discarded rather than normalized.
safeErrorTelemetryAudit.reason: The committed safe artifact has null parameter and no raw response. The exact discarded value, if one existed, is intentionally unavailable post hoc.
safeErrorTelemetryAudit.candidateNarrowImprovement: In a separate package, allow a bounded syntax-validated parameter path rooted only at response_format, model, messages, provider, max_tokens, temperature, store, or stream; retain normalized root plus safe schema-keyword class while discarding property/literal values. Add redaction fixtures before any live use.

rankedHypotheses.exactDifferingConstruct: Current schema has nine pattern nodes versus one in both accepted real and accepted full-planner synthetic requests; seven patterns constrain typed reference aliases and one newly constrains issueId.
rankedHypotheses.whyItCouldExplainHttp400: It is the largest newly introduced schema-keyword-class delta and affects the formerly successful authorization control.
rankedHypotheses.evidenceSupporting: It is the largest newly introduced schema-keyword-class delta and affects the formerly successful authorization control.
rankedHypotheses.evidenceAgainst: JSON Schema pattern is structurally valid, and one pattern was previously accepted; repository evidence does not prove a pattern count or regex-feature limit.
rankedHypotheses.offlineFalsification: Not falsifiable offline because local translation/validation accepts it.
rankedHypotheses.smallestFutureLiveTest: After exact accepted controls, send one synthetic full-planner request changing only the seven reference item constraints from historical enums to the current typed patterns.

rankedHypotheses.whyItCouldExplainHttp400: The name is part of response_format and therefore request-level validation.
rankedHypotheses.evidenceSupporting: The name is part of response_format and therefore request-level validation.
rankedHypotheses.evidenceAgainst: Both names are syntax-safe and multiple historical names were accepted; name alone does not explain the construct-focused error.
rankedHypotheses.offlineFalsification: Offline syntax checks eliminate malformed-character and length concerns, not provider semantics.
rankedHypotheses.smallestFutureLiveTest: Only if pattern isolation succeeds, change the accepted synthetic full-planner schema name alone to the stable name.

rankedHypotheses.exactDifferingConstruct: IssueId/inputHash request-binding consts were removed from provider schema and issueId became a pattern under strict=true.
rankedHypotheses.whyItCouldExplainHttp400: Provider structured-output validators may reject a valid local combination even when individual keywords are supported.
rankedHypotheses.evidenceSupporting: Provider structured-output validators may reject a valid local combination even when individual keywords are supported.
rankedHypotheses.evidenceAgainst: Strict mode, const, and the inputHash pattern were accepted before; local schema remains deterministic and closed.
rankedHypotheses.offlineFalsification: Offline comparison identifies the exact delta but cannot emulate routed Anthropic validation.
rankedHypotheses.smallestFutureLiveTest: Use synthetic data and change only issueId const to the current issueId pattern after reference-pattern testing.

rankedHypotheses.exactDifferingConstruct: Package B changes raw internal references to request-scoped typed aliases and changes the provider-bound input hash/user message.
rankedHypotheses.whyItCouldExplainHttp400: It affects the control request and is the only major message-content delta.
rankedHypotheses.evidenceSupporting: It affects the control request and is the only major message-content delta.
rankedHypotheses.evidenceAgainst: Ordinary message strings should not cause request-parameter rejection; privacy aliases passed all local validators and contain no unsupported top-level parameter.
rankedHypotheses.offlineFalsification: Offline validation eliminates malformed JSON, envelope, reference-class, and binding errors.
rankedHypotheses.smallestFutureLiveTest: A synthetic request with the accepted schema and only alias-shaped synthetic reference values would isolate content from schema.

rankedHypotheses.exactDifferingConstruct: A previously accepted control now fails despite identical transport/generation/routing parameters.
rankedHypotheses.whyItCouldExplainHttp400: All four current requests failed uniformly, including the control, and no returned model was recorded.
rankedHypotheses.evidenceSupporting: All four current requests failed uniformly, including the control, and no returned model was recorded.
rankedHypotheses.evidenceAgainst: This is vague and not tied to a repository request delta; accepted historical evidence cannot establish present service behavior.
rankedHypotheses.smallestFutureLiveTest: First replay the exact minimal accepted synthetic request, then the exact full-planner synthetic request, with zero retries.

rankedHypotheses.exactDifferingConstruct: Request size or a top-level parameter was rejected.
rankedHypotheses.evidenceAgainst: Eliminated as a material request-shape delta: top-level keys and values are unchanged, and the rejected request is smaller than accepted planner-shaped requests.
rankedHypotheses.offlineFalsification: Eliminated offline for the recorded shapes, except for unobserved provider policy drift.
rankedHypotheses.smallestFutureLiveTest: No size-specific live test recommended before higher-ranked controls.
